purpose: Blueprint for the public/customer-facing GitHub App that owns the ANPOS GitHub Marketplace listing, supports Marketplace account reconciliation, and provides the Community read-only ANPOS Repository Readiness / Conformance Audit. This file is not an App registration and contains no credentials.
permission_rule: Community v1 must use the narrow multiple-single-files read permission for exactly the ten approved ANPOS control files plus GitHub's baseline metadata read. Do not request broad repository Contents access for the readiness audit. Add any future permission only when a concrete customer-facing capability requires it and re-review the Marketplace installation consent surface.
security_requirements: This App must be distinct from the private Vendor Distribution GitHub App.
Generate its private key and client secret only in GitHub and store them in an approved secret manager; never commit them.
Use a strong Marketplace webhook secret and verify webhook signatures before processing payloads.
Do not grant vendor private-template Administration permission to this customer-facing App.
Community repository audit must not read application source code; it may read only the approved single_file_paths through a repository-scoped installation token.
A repository audit must also authenticate the requesting GitHub user; an installation_id or repository string alone is not user authorization.
GitHub Marketplace setup URL and user authorization/callback flows must be completed before customer launch; setup identifiers received from redirects are untrusted until independently verified.
Do not claim Marketplace publication, installation count, publisher verification, pricing, or free-plan value from this blueprint.
Re-check current GitHub Marketplace and GitHub App visibility/permission requirements immediately before registration/listing submission.
